title: Great app for simple habit tracking with notes! Love it!
body: Useful and simple app just like I was trying to find! Best for simple and efficient tracking. Also beautifully designed app and easy to use! If you’re looking for something easy to use, with no distractions, this is best app for you.
author: Mcalic

title: Great tracking app!
body: App is great, very simple, yet with many customizable options, as well as templating options. What I like is the widget as well which reminds me of my challenge track each day!
author: Subasic Jovana

title: Only 2 habits without premium
body: App looks nice, has simbole design, but having only 2 habits to track without premium plan.. I have nothing against it, I just wish it was said earlier (for example, here).
author: Willymitz

title: Free
body:
It has all you need free to use + there are no ada, as far as I am aware.
Really like the looks of the app, as well. Recommend. 🍋
